summary: Prepared raw marketing HTML can hard-code /assets/config.js even though page-kit publishes campaign assets at the campaign root.
details: During the Lumi Demeter-clone dogfood build, raw presell/landing HTML initially injected /lumi-v0/assets/config.js and /lumi-v0/assets/products/... paths. next-campaign-page-kit renders src/<campaign>/assets/config.js as /<campaign>/config.js and src/<campaign>/assets/products/foo.png as /<campaign>/products/foo.png. The correct page-kit source convention is Liquid helpers such as {{ 'config.js' | campaign_asset }} or, for raw passthrough pages, a campaign-rooted URL. The tools should make this deterministic so agents do not infer the output path by inspecting _site.
expected: Campaigns OS setup/build guidance or doctor should state and/or validate the page-kit asset contract for prepared raw HTML: assets/ source files publish at the campaign root, and source should prefer campaign_asset/campaign_link helpers where Liquid is available.
actual: The agent inferred and patched hard-coded routeRoot paths after doctor warned about missing /assets/config.js.

summary: Demeter clone-first commerce pages dramatically reduced checkout-surface repair work.
details: Compared with the prior free-form Lumi checkout attempt, this run preserved Demeter payment, express wallets, address rows, bundle selector, opt-in bump, order summary, upsell controls, and receipt surfaces. Local and preview Campaigns OS browser QA both passed 50/50, including card iframe geometry, wallet dimensions, bump state, bundle price visibility, and Demeter structure contract.
expected: Campaigns OS should bias commerce-heavy pages toward direct starter-template clones with styling applied on top until free-form commerce components have stronger contracts.
actual: The Demeter clone path reached a preview-ready branch with only light copy/style cleanup and no manual commerce DOM reconstruction.

summary: Campaign assembly still requires bespoke source-to-page-kit adapter code for prepared HTML.
details: The Lumi run needed a hand-authored assembler to clone Demeter atomically, copy product images, inject config.js, localize raw marketing links, scrub demo upsell copy, normalize whitespace, update campaigns.json, and maintain runtime artifacts. Several of those steps are deterministic and should be generated or checked by Campaigns OS/page-kit contracts rather than inferred by agents.
expected: A setup/build helper should produce a page-kit adapter plan or scaffold with explicit asset mapping, config helper usage, route/link mapping, template clone rules, unsupported surface removals, and runtime report updates.
actual: The agent built scripts/assemble-lumi-demeter.mjs by reading templates, prior assemblers, doctor output, and rendered _site output.
